title: Stop Wasting Money on These 5 Daily Habits
script:
“Do you ever feel your wallet whisper, “What have you been getting into?”—a soft, guilty hiss that makes you second‑guess every breath you take? Trust me, you’re not alone. Let’s unravel the five sneaky habits that quietly bleed your bank account dry, and learn how to stop the bleeding, one breath at a time.”

1️⃣ The daily coffee run  
Every morning, that barista’s latte cup becomes a tiny vault of your Sunday fries. Why pay $4 for a steaming cup when a sturdy mug at home does the job just as well? Think on that next cup—and on the extra $48 you’ll spare yourself in a year! 2️⃣ Unused subscriptions  
Do those Netflix, Spotify, or ‘premium’ apps you’ve forgotten add up? You’re paying you for niceties you never touch. A clean sweep could free up hundreds for real adventures. 3️⃣ Impulse online binges  
Click that “Add to Cart!”—it’s a shortcut to a “Forget‑It‑All” nightmare. Shop with a list or set a removal timer. Your future self will thank you.
